home.missionBody: We treat the traditional costume as a central element of Algerian cultural identity. Our mission is to document it, protect it from disappearance, and turn it into economic products marketable locally, nationally, and internationally.

about.title: About us
about.intro: Anamil El Aouras Wa El Zibane is an emerging cultural-economic project that values the traditional women's costume of the Mchounèche region by combining anthropological research with investment in the creative industries.
about.visionBody: Turning the project from a production workshop into a digital cultural-economic platform that combines anthropological archiving, e-commerce, and interactive cultural tourism.
goalsScientificItems: Document the traditional women's costume of Mchounèche through field anthropology
Analyze the symbolic and social meanings of the garments
Study the evolution of the costume across generations
goalsCulturalItems: Value the traditional costume as a cultural and economic product
Contribute to protecting Algerian material heritage

items.q: What is Anamil El Aouras Wa El Zibane?
items.a: A cultural-economic project that documents and markets the traditional women's costume of Mchounèche, via a digital platform combining scientific research and e-commerce.
We ship within Algeria through local partners, and internationally via certified postal services. Times and costs are shown at checkout.
Yes, every heritage piece is hand-made by local artisans following traditional methods, with a certificate attached to each item.

items.q: Can I order a custom size?
items.a: Yes, most products offer custom-size options. Please contact us before ordering to confirm the details.
